column1: The IS–LM model has played a central role in the history of economic thought, and it offers a powerful lens through which to view economic history, but it has much modern significance as well. Throughout this chapter we will see that the model can also be used to shed light on more recent fluctuations in the economy; two case studies in the chapter use it to examine the recessions that began in 2001 and 2008. Moreover, as we will see in Chapter 15, the logic of the IS–LM model provides a good foundation for understanding newer and more sophisticated theories of the business cycle.
